Name: Strength
Description: Strength is the measure of your physical power and might.

Name: Dexterity
Description: Dexterity is the measure of your agility, reflexes, and balance.

Name: Constitution
Description: Constitution is the measure of your health, stamina, and resilience.

Name: Intelligence
Description: Intelligence is the measure of your reasoning, memory, and analytical skill.

Name: Wisdom
Description: Wisdom is the measure of your perception, intuition, and insight.

Name: Charisma
Description: Charisma is the measure of your force of personality, persuasiveness, and leadership.
